relationships.subject: eptinezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The most effective was Eptinezumab 300mg (MD -2.46, 95% Credible Interval (CrI) -3.23 to -1.69)

relationships.subject: fremanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The most effective drug is Fremanezumab-monthly (MD: -2.77, 95% CrI: -3.37 to -2.16)

key_findings: Network meta-analysis of 12 RCTs: all six drugs reduced monthly headache and migraine days vs placebo, with modest absolute effects; eptinezumab 300mg best for headache days, fremanezumab monthly for migraine days.
CGRP mAbs more effective than topiramate but only marginally better than BTA.
